interpretation: These are source-Python production-engine builds, not packaged executable or UI responsiveness benchmarks.
Each size has one measured run per product. Caches were not flushed. Ascending size and product order may affect timings.
Input copies are prepared outside the timer and can warm the filesystem cache. Cold storage reads and network-share performance are not measured.
Main builder runs 15 supported modules and creates a combined Word report. TA runs its three module pipelines. Total runtimes represent different scopes.
PerfMon, activity logs, SQL and hardware examples remain fixed; endpoint records and UDP/setting distributions grow.
The fixed PerfMon fixture has 360 readings and 232 counters. Longer or larger PerfMon captures, larger logs and larger property catalogues can require additional time and memory.
The supplied friendly Top 10 CSV is used, as selected by the ordinary folder discovery. Raw timing XML aggregation is not part of these builds.
Peak job commit includes all descendant processes and is kernel tracked. Live private memory and working-set sums are sampled once per second.
Elapsed wall time includes process startup and up to one second of completion-polling granularity. Preparation/copying, baseline sampling and output verification are excluded.
System CPU, paging, disk and available memory include other applications. Background workload was measured, not controlled.
A single 64 GB workstation establishes observed usage and runtime, not a validated minimum hardware specification.
note: No new benchmark runs were performed while preparing this report. Main Report Builder measurements are not included in these TA runs.
